name: Kuki Hikaru
source:
The oldest of the three Kuki brothers who transferred into Nanashina Senior High School. Hikaru is the younger brother of his twin, Shizuka. As the distinguished son and heir of a large zaibatsu, he has been undertaking training towards that end since he was small. As a result, Hikaru is intelligent and good with words. Excelling at using people, he holds the most authority out of the Kuki brothers.

[Translation of his [URL=http://rejetweb.jp/moshikami/character/hikaru.html]official website profile[/URL].]
